ReportRecord.title: ReportRecord
ReportRecord.description: Operational transaction or event record synced from a source system for reporting and aggregation.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns or synced this report record.

sourceSystem.description: Identifier of the external system or database module (e.g. ERP-SAP, POS-Branch, Shopee-OMS, CRM-Hub).

referenceCode.description: Document or transaction reference number from the source system.

title.description: Summary title or item description of the transaction.

department.description: Department or branch associated with the record.

amount.description: Monetary value in THB associated with the record.

recordDate.description: Effective transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was ingested.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

ReportTemplate.title: ReportTemplate
ReportTemplate.description: Saved report query configuration and filter preset for recurring cross-system reporting.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the report template.

name.description: Display name of the saved report template.

description.description: Explanation of the report scope and purpose.

sourceSystemFilter.description: Target source system filter or ALL.

groupByField.description: Dimension field used to aggregate the report.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the template was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the template was last updated.

/report_records/{recordId}.description: Stores synced and imported operational records from connected systems for reporting.

/report_templates/{templateId}.description: Stores user-defined report filter presets and aggregation configurations.
